keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Columbus Crew 1, D.C. United 0. Sean Zawadzki (Columbus Crew) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Dylan Chambost with a cross following a set piece situation.
Penalty missed. Keisuke Kurokawa (D.C. United) left footed shot is close, but misses to the right.
Goal! Columbus Crew 2, D.C. United 0. Anass Zaroury (Columbus Crew) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Dylan Chambost.
Kye Rowles (D.C. United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Columbus Crew 2, D.C. United 0.
Substitution, D.C. United. Oscar Avilez replaces Jared Stroud.
Delay in match because of an injury Sékou Bangoura (Columbus Crew).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, D.C. United. Brandon Servania replaces Nathan Ordaz.
Own Goal by Kimito Nono, D.C. United. Columbus Crew 3, D.C. United 0.
Peglow (D.C. United) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, D.C. United. Sean Nealis replaces Kye Rowles.
Substitution, Columbus Crew. Tarun Karumanchi replaces Sékou Bangoura.
Substitution, Columbus Crew. Josef Martínez replaces Gonzalo Tapia.
Substitution, Columbus Crew. Andrés Herrera replaces Mohamed Farsi.
